biotools.summary: quicksand is an open-source Nextflow pipeline for rapid taxonomic classification of mammalian mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) in sedaDNA samples. It combines fast alignment-free classification with post-classification mapping, filtering, and ancient DNA authentication.
